say:2:1410418001:0.text: High Priestess! A suspicious commoner has likely disguised themselves as a lowborn and infiltrated the royal city!
say:2:1410418001:0.source_cn: 冕下，我要举报！有个可疑的平民疑似装扮成仆从混入王城！
say:2:1410418001:0.male: High Priestess! A suspicious commoner has likely disguised themselves as a lowborn and infiltrated the royal city!
say:2:1410418001:0.female: High Priestess! A suspicious commoner has likely disguised themselves as a lowborn and infiltrated the royal city!

say:3:1410418002:1.text: I'm certain that wretch is plotting against our sacred Queen!
say:3:1410418002:1.source_cn: 那家伙肯定是想危害伟大的女王！
say:3:1410418002:1.male: I'm certain that wretch is plotting against our sacred Queen!
say:3:1410418002:1.female: I'm certain that wretch is plotting against our sacred Queen!

say:4:1410418003:1.text: A threat to the Queen? Bring forth the accused.
say:4:1410418003:1.source_cn: 对女王不利？将嫌疑者带上来。
say:4:1410418003:1.male: A threat to the Queen? Bring forth the accused.
say:4:1410418003:1.female: A threat to the Queen? Bring forth the accused.

choice_prompt:5:1410418003.text: A threat to the Queen? Bring forth the accused.
choice_prompt:5:1410418003.source_cn: 对女王不利？将嫌疑者带上来。
choice_prompt:5:1410418003.male: A threat to the Queen? Bring forth the accused.
choice_prompt:5:1410418003.female: A threat to the Queen? Bring forth the accused.

say:6:1410418004:0.text: Speak! Who is your master? Who brought you here?
say:6:1410418004:0.source_cn: 那你是谁家的仆从，谁带你来的！说啊？
say:6:1410418004:0.male: Speak! Who is your master? Who brought you here?
say:6:1410418004:0.female: Speak! Who is your master? Who brought you here?

say:7:1410418005:1.text: Hmph! I saw through you from the start. You're definitely a commoner trying to pass as one of us!
say:7:1410418005:1.source_cn: 哼，我早就看穿了！你绝对是混进来的平民！
say:7:1410418005:1.male: Hmph! I saw through you from the start. You're definitely a commoner trying to pass as one of us!
say:7:1410418005:1.female: Hmph! I saw through you from the start. You're definitely a commoner trying to pass as one of us!

say:8:1410418008:1.text: You overestimate the threat of a single commoner, Lord Andeno.
say:8:1410418008:1.source_cn: 安心，一个微不足道的平民，还伤害不了我们全能的女王。
say:8:1410418008:1.male: You overestimate the threat of a single commoner, Lord Andeno.
say:8:1410418008:1.female: You overestimate the threat of a single commoner, Lord Andeno.

say:9:1410418009:1.text: With loyal soldiers at my side, Captain Indris at the helm, and the Queen's will guiding us... what danger could such an insignificant soul possibly pose?
say:9:1410418009:1.source_cn: 在场有忠诚的卫兵、卫队长，甚至还有我，又有什么好担心的呢？

say:10:1410418010:1.text: ... You are right, of course. I trust you will pass fair judgment upon this transgressor.
say:10:1410418010:1.source_cn: ……您说得对！您一定能秉公处理这可恶的平民！
say:10:1410418010:1.male: ... You are right, of course. I trust you will pass fair judgment upon this transgressor.
say:10:1410418010:1.female: ... You are right, of course. I trust you will pass fair judgment upon this transgressor.

choice_prompt:11:1410418010.text: ... You are right, of course. I trust you will pass fair judgment upon this transgressor.
choice_prompt:11:1410418010.source_cn: ……您说得对！您一定能秉公处理这可恶的平民！
choice_prompt:11:1410418010.male: ... You are right, of course. I trust you will pass fair judgment upon this transgressor.
choice_prompt:11:1410418010.female: ... You are right, of course. I trust you will pass fair judgment upon this transgressor.

say:12:1410418011:1.source_cn: 不过，平民，你触犯了律法，必须施于应有的惩罚。

say:13:1410418012:1.text: Captain Indris, you have always upheld justice. What punishment does our law prescribe?
say:13:1410418012:1.source_cn: 就像因度厄卫队长一样，这是公平的明证。
say:13:1410418012:1.male: Captain Indris, you have always upheld justice. What punishment does our law prescribe?
say:13:1410418012:1.female: Captain Indris, you have always upheld justice. What punishment does our law prescribe?

say:16:1410418013:0.text: The standard sentence for a commoner trespassing on restricted grounds is seven days under the Stigma of Judgment.
say:16:1410418013:0.source_cn: 我对惩罚毫无怨言。但冕下，根据律法，平民擅入处罚是七日...

say:17:1410418014:1.text: Seven days... You are merciful as ever, Captain. Very well. Let it be so.
say:17:1410418014:1.source_cn: 因度厄，你对平民还是如此宽宥……就依你所言吧，遵守律法。

say:18:1410418015:1.text: But you understand, do you not, Indris? Punishment is not cruelty—it is discipline. A lesson, not a condemnation.
say:18:1410418015:1.source_cn: 我相信，即使在接受惩罚后……你还是能履行好自己的责任，对吗？

say:19:1410418016:0.text: I do, High Priestess. I do not resent the law, nor do I forsake my duty.
say:19:1410418016:0.source_cn: 奎茵冕下，我永远不会因为惩罚而心怀怨恨，更不会玷污自己...

say:20:1410418017:0.text: Then, all is as it should be.
say:20:1410418017:0.source_cn: 你明白便好。这次的惩戒只是为了让你吸取教训，更加忠诚。

say:21:1410418018:0.text: Captain Indris, you are young, but your dedication is admirable. The Queen recognizes loyalty when she sees it.
say:21:1410418018:0.source_cn: 因度厄，你是位有才能的年轻人。女王总会予以特殊的宽容。

say:22:1410418019:1.text: And let all here remember—the Queen's mercy is boundless.
say:22:1410418019:1.source_cn: 在场者请记住，女王的慈悲远超你们的想象。

say:23:1410418020:1.text: Though Indris bears the Stigma, his station remains. For even in punishment, the Queen's hand uplifts the worthy.
say:23:1410418020:1.source_cn: 因度厄卫队长的惩罚印记只是无法领取灵露，但他的职务将予...

say:24:1410418021:1.text: The Queen loves her people as a mother loves her child. Discipline guides, mercy nurtures, and together, they shape a brighter future.
say:24:1410418021:1.source_cn: 女王如母亲般爱护萨洛克兰的子民——她的惩罚是为了让我们...

cinematic_dialogue:28:1410419001:.text: May her radiance light your path.
cinematic_dialogue:28:1410419001:.male: May her radiance light your path.
cinematic_dialogue:28:1410419001:.female: May her radiance light your path.

narration:30:140104113:0.text: Velara marks you with the Stigma of Judgment. The guards come over, ready to throw you out of the royal city.
narration:30:140104113:0.source_cn: 奎茵施法为你烙上了惩罚印记，卫兵们随后上前来要把你驱逐...
narration:30:140104113:0.male: Velara marks you with the Stigma of Judgment. The guards come over, ready to throw you out of the royal city.
narration:30:140104113:0.female: Velara marks you with the Stigma of Judgment. The guards come over, ready to throw you out of the royal city.

choice:5:0:1.text: Look, if you just let me explain.
choice:5:0:1.male: Look, if you just let me explain.
choice:5:0:1.female: Look, if you just let me explain.

say:31:1410418006:1.text: Hah! Silence is an admission of guilt! You've committed a grave offense!
say:31:1410418006:1.source_cn: 不说话就是承认了！你犯了大罪！
say:31:1410418006:1.male: Hah! Silence is an admission of guilt! You've committed a grave offense!
say:31:1410418006:1.female: Hah! Silence is an admission of guilt! You've committed a grave offense!

say:32:1410418007:1.text: High Priestess, this commoner dares to defy us. Surely, that alone warrants harsher punishment!
say:32:1410418007:1.source_cn: 奎茵冕下，这平民试图违抗，应当罪加一等！
say:32:1410418007:1.male: High Priestess, this commoner dares to defy us. Surely, that alone warrants harsher punishment!
say:32:1410418007:1.female: High Priestess, this commoner dares to defy us. Surely, that alone warrants harsher punishment!
